Generate age distributions

Source: R/sim_diags_fns.R
generate_age_dist.Rd

Generates age distributions for a given number of age categories over the epidemic.

Usage

generate_age_dist(nquar, nage = 52, pattern, peak_start = 10, peak_end = 30)

Arguments

nquar

Number of time quarters.

nage

Number of age groups.

pattern

Pattern type for age distribution ("constant", "wedge", "varying_wedge").

peak_start

Peak age during first time quarter.

peak_end

Peak age during final time quarter.

Value

Matrix of age distribution over time.
